description: Advisory completeness checks for the default-host /m image-query producer in WCS SDK 0.8.32. The current page URL, SDK version and time slot stay nonempty. An optional submitted wa is checked for emptiness only. Loader URLs, POST /b, configurable hosts, conversion schemas and identifier or clock grammars remain outside this profile.

params.name: u
params.description: The SDK query constructor always copies window.location.href into u. Only nonempty template completeness is checked; no unproved URL-scheme restriction is imposed.

params.name: vs
params.description: The SDK emits its version string. Future version strings are not constrained to a closed grammar.

params.name: nt
params.description: The SDK emits the current time slot. This profile does not assert numeric syntax, time bounds or clock correctness.

params.name: wa
params.description: The SDK copies configured wa to the query. Check submitted emptiness only. Its absence, identifier spelling and relationship to the separately copied legacy i are not contracted.

params.name: e
params.description: The SDK explicitly emits an empty e when document.referrer is unavailable. It is not required by this partial profile.

params.name: method
params.description: The source image transport uses GET. A different method on this query profile is advisory; no body protocol or rejection policy is asserted.
